### [Louvre Photo](/en/what-s-on/exhibitions/louvre-photo)

Through more than 300 photos of the Louvre – its visitors both famous and anonymous, its hidden nooks and behind-the-scenes corridors – ‘Louvre Photo’ invites visitors on a photographic journey through history to the present day. Beginning 4 November 2026.

Exhibition

![](https://api-www.louvre.fr/sites/default/files/2026-07/Wordsworth_image_2.jpg)

### [On the Roads of Medieval Karakum (Turkmenistan)](/en/what-s-on/on-the-roads-of-medieval-karakum-turkmenistan)

The relation between the Silk Road and the cities of Merv, Bukhara and Samarkand – major stops along the network – has long been described as symbiotic, but what of the smaller towns and outposts dotted throughout the desert? Lecture, 12 November, 12:30 pm

Lectures
